name: NVIDIA/SkillSpector
title: NVIDIA/SkillSpector
summary: Security scanner for AI agent skills. Detect vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, security risks, prompt injection, data exfiltration, and supply-chain risks in Claude Code, Codex, and MCP skills before you install them.

possibilities.title: AppSec teams can cross-check two trending audit skills and triage only disagreements

with.title: Claude-BugHunter skill bundle keeps climbing GitHub trending
Cloudflare security-audit-skill holds monthly GitHub trending spot

possibilities.connection: SkillSpector vets Claude-BugHunter and Cloudflare's audit skill before install, and running both on one repo turns their overlap into a confidence signal.

possibilities.title: Regulated firms can trial community bug-hunting skills inside their own AWS account

with.title: Claude-BugHunter packages structured security review skills
Claude Code runs remotely on Bedrock AgentCore

possibilities.connection: SkillSpector scans the Claude-BugHunter bundle for prompt injection and supply-chain risk before install, and Bedrock AgentCore runs Claude Code with those skills in isolated sessions in the firm's own AWS account, returning findings as pull requests.

possibilities.title: Game studios can let agents drive Blender and Unreal with scanned skills and budgets

with.title: Scenario skills drive image, video, audio and 3D generation
Casdoor adds identity and gateway for agents and MCP

possibilities.connection: Scenario's MCP lets agents price media jobs and drive Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal and Unity, SkillSpector scans the skill package before install, and Casdoor puts identity in front of the MCP tools.

possibilities.title: Platform teams can gate every agent skill install behind a scan this quarter

with.title: Backdoor found in Claude Code extension on Cursor Marketplace
Vercel's open agent skills tool via npx skills

possibilities.connection: The Cursor Marketplace backdoor shows agent add-ons are a live supply chain risk, npx skills gives one install path to control, and SkillSpector can scan skills for injection and exfiltration before that path lets them through.
